Fatema Begum daughter of Azizer Rahman
Vs.
Aminur Rahman Son of Afser Ali and others
full_judgment: 15. P.W. 4 Md. Paniruddin has deposed that on 28.6.2002 Friday at about 10-00 a.m. he went to the father's house of the informant and saw many persons assembled there. That he saw Azizar (informant's father) his wife, Arif, Hasan and Fatema lying unconscious. Later he, with the help of other persons, took them to the Aditmari Hospital for treatment. That Saturday he went to hospital and saw that the father and mother of the informant regained sense partially and Arif, Hasan and Fatema regained full sense and they were a bit well. That at that time he saw nail marks on the throat of Fatema. That three days after returning from the hospital the informant narrated the occurrence to him. That the informant told about the fact of her being raped by 3 persons. During cross-examination this witness has given a more detailed picture of the P.O. house as he saw on the next morning of the occurrence. The witness has stated that Azizar Rahman (informant's father) was lying unconscious on the floor of east-bhiti room with froth coming out of his mouth and urine in his wearing cloths, that Hasan and Arif also were lying unconscious with urine in their wearing cloths. Amena Khatun (informant's mother) also was unconscious and was lying in a position of ‘shijda’ on the floor of north-bhiti room. In course of cross-examination this witness has further stated that he is the sister's husband of the informant and that the father of accused Aminur filed an objection under section 30 in respect of his homestead land but did not win. From the cross examination of this witness it has come out that on the next morning of the occurrence a G.D. entry was made by some neighbour as regards the occurrence. However, from the lengthy cross-examination of this witness also nothing material came out to raise any suspicion about the prosecution case or to make this witness himself untrustworthy.
